metadata.title: SDLC Assurance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for producing and maintaining security assurance evidence for SDLC artifacts without granting authorization to deploy or execute.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Software assurance tooling, CI/CD testing stages, static and dynamic analysis pipelines.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Solution pattern for generating SDLC assurance evidence.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines test results, scan output, validation artifacts, and assurance attestations as trust-relevant SDLC data.

props.name: nist-controls
props.remarks: SDLC Assurance implements assessment and integrity-related controls.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secure Software Development Framework guidance for software assurance practices.

metadata.remarks: SDLC Assurance produces security assurance evidence for SDLC artifacts. Assurance demonstrates assessed properties but does not imply authorization, deployment approval, or runtime safety.

components.title: SDLC Assurance Scope
components.description: Defines which SDLC artifacts are subject to security assurance activities.

components.title: Static Assurance Analysis
components.description: Performs static analysis on SDLC artifacts such as source code, scripts, IaC, and policy-as-code.

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise
techniques.remarks: Insertion of malicious logic or insecure constructs into SDLC artifacts.

techniques.name: Static Code Analysis
techniques.remarks: Detection of insecure patterns prior to build or release.

components.title: Dynamic and Runtime Assurance Testing
components.description: Performs dynamic analysis and testing in controlled environments.

techniques.name: Process Injection
techniques.remarks: Injected runtime behavior revealed during dynamic testing.

techniques.name: Dynamic Application Testing
techniques.remarks: Runtime behavior testing to validate assurance claims.

components.title: Assurance Evidence Preservation
components.description: Preserves assurance results for audit, review, and downstream decision-making.

components.title: Assurance Non-Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Defines what assurance results do not grant or imply.
components.remarks: Passing assurance checks does not imply approval to deploy, authority to execute, or safety in OT or IoMT environments.
